Coil: figure-of-eight coil (Double 70-mm Alpha Coil). Number of channels: 62-channel EEG channels (AFz and TP9 are used as reference and ground, respectively) + 1 FDI EMG channel + 1 electrode on the outer canthus of the left eye to monitor eye movements.
